title: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 3: Uhuru wa wanyama)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the utanzu with the right term, proves each point with a line or event from "Kisima cha Matumaini", and says what it does in the work.

floor.prerequisite: Answers comprehension questions from a passage.
floor.question: Jibu linatoka wapi?

representations: the class novela "Kisima cha Matumaini" with key pages marked
steps: Read the question and the term.
Find the part of the work.
Write the point with its evidence.
contexts: a school drama or poetry festival

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes one point with its evidence and its importance in the frame.

misconceptions.ask: Sifa hii inapatikana katika novela au katika hadithi fupi?
misconceptions.repair: Novela ni hadithi ndefu ya kubuni yenye wahusika na matukio mengi.
Novela ni fasihi andishi: imeandikwa na mwandishi anayejulikana.

misconceptions.ask: Maana yako inataja muundo na lengo pia?
misconceptions.repair: Maana kamili ya novela hutaja aina yake, muundo wake na lengo lake.

misconceptions.ask: Jina la mwandishi liko wapi kitabuni?
misconceptions.repair: Mwandishi ni mtunzi; msimulizi na wahusika ni sehemu ya kazi.

checks.question: Ni sifa ipi ni ya novela?
checks.answer: ni hadithi ndefu kuliko hadithi fupi yenye wahusika na matukio mengi

checks.question: Novela ni utanzu wa fasihi ipi?
